description:
Buffalo Bills at Houston Texans
Houston Texans host the Buffalo Bills in a regular-season NFL Week 1 game at NRG Stadium. The Houston Texans look to build on a twelve-win season last year, while the Buffalo Bills attempt to edge past a matching twelve-win 2025 campaign.

title: NFL Football
description:
Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings
The Minnesota Vikings host the Green Bay Packers in NFL Week 1 game at U.S. Bank Stadium. The NFC North rivals split their 2025 head-to-head series 1-1. The Vikings finished last season with a 9-8 record, while the Packers finished 9-7-1.
